lifecycle: CordisBoundNodeHost.drain -> NodeContainer.drain when measured in_flight is zero
CordisBoundNodeHost.dispose -> reverse Cordis Fiber disposal -> NodeContainer.dispose
mount failure -> NodeContainer.fail -> reverse Cordis Fiber disposal -> NodeContainer.dispose
graph_binding_rule: the actual mounted Cordis plugin plan entries must equal the immutable NodePluginPlan entries; graph_hash, manifest_hash, loaded_plan_hash and plan.hash must be the same verified hash before Rust declaration
in_flight_rule: Rust NodeContainer owns the atomic in-flight count; the JS host mirrors and cross-checks it after each enter/exit; drain rejects when the measured count is non-zero
transport_rule: the lifecycle port is a persistent line-delimited typed operation channel; each message is a declared lifecycle operation, never a business payload or metadata carrier
forbidden: control/debug/error fields in provider or client business payload
required_tests: real Cordis mount drives Rust state to accepting
in-flight execution rejects drain and leaves state accepting
Cordis graph/plan drift rejects before Rust declaration
Cordis mount failure drives Rust candidate through failed to disposed
